title: Analysis: CXMT sees edge AI driving memory growth as enterprise and device markets emerge as twin engines
html:
ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) held an earnings briefing on November 17, during which company director and president Cao Kanyu outlined the outlook for enterprise, edge-device, consumer, and automotive memory markets.
